review_evidence: README states that the repository contains AI-generated mathematics checked by Lean with no sorry/axiom placeholders.
Representative ProblemFourteen, Landau, ForwardEuler, and Binomial modules contain substantive formal definitions and theorems.
Generated provenance alone is not a lossless-noise criterion: the checked formal statements/proofs are reusable prior-art signal.
summary: Retain merely-true: its Lean modules are machine-checked theorem statements and proofs across several mathematical topics, even though the README records AI-generated provenance.
